in_sanskrit.name: राञ्जित्राज
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who is the king of the realm, one who has the power and ability to rule over a kingdom.

in_hindi.name: राञ्जित्राज
in_hindi.long_meaning: A king who rules or governs effectively over a kingdom.

in_tamil.name: ராஞ்சித்ராஜ
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who is the king of life, the one who is the ruler and protector of life.

in_telugu.name: రాఞ్జిత్రాజ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who is the king of all and the ruler of all.

in_marathi.name: Ranjitraj
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ranjitraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who brings joy to the king, Raja meaning king, iti meaning joy

in_bengali.name: Ranjitraj
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Joyful King
in_bengali.long_meaning: Ranjitraj একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who brings joy to the king, Raja meaning king, iti meaning joy
